A large abstract earth-toned painting hangs on the kitchen wall. Floor-to-ceiling black metal-framed glass sliding doors dominate the right wall, flooding the space with diffuse outdoor daylight and revealing a garden beyond. To the left, a dramatic curved concrete spiral staircase ascends with sculptural presence. The walls and ceiling are smooth white plaster. The color palette is warm neutral with rich brown, light oak, caramel, and stone.
